release.full_package_tests_conclusion: success: Go/race and all six distribution lifecycle tests

behavior: Native instance with no saved plan and no legacy Slots initializes a persisted target of 16 after candidates are available
Allocates and binds entries without posting the target form, then uses the existing connection concurrency budget
Buffered pool refresh signal wakes reconciliation without waiting from a reconnect worker or holding manager locks
Existing plans including zero, legacy Slots, port/authentication/policy identities and non-native backends preserved
Final explicit deletion of legacy Slots persists zero so the default cannot recreate them
No pool means no new exits; insufficient admin capacity reports an error rather than silently lowering the target
Unverified or failed candidates remain waiting and are not published as usable subscription entries
First-use action is refresh candidates; target form suggests 16 for untouched instances
Uninstaller accepts canonical empty Go slice null but refuses malformed non-array records

full_package_lifecycle: Install with empty/unavailable pool and working direct subscription HTTPS
Update before candidate acquisition keeps empty state and private identity
Controlled HTTPS candidate pool automatically creates and binds exactly 16 unverified exits without target submission
Stop synthetic exits, update, compare Slot/port/SOCKS credential/policy identities and native management state
Save explicit zero target and disable direct, update, verify zero remains and direct stays disabled
Complete uninstall and precise network cleanup after all exits removed

retained_failed_rounds.finding: Harness compared automatic Slot identities during the earlier empty-pool stage; split empty-pool update from post-bootstrap update
Harness posted an empty policy with zero target and product correctly refused it; test now preserves the actual valid policy like the UI
Automatic allocation, identity preservation and zero-target update passed, but real uninstall rejected canonical tunnels:null; fixed product parser with strict malformed-list regressions

limitations: Controlled candidate traffic to its exact public fixture IP/port is rejected within disposable containers; this is not real VPN Gate positive connectivity
Candidate availability and health do not guarantee 16 ready exits
No production VPS deployment or mutation in this round; user can upgrade through the existing updater
Container tests do not replace independent VPS kernel/SELinux/firewalld validation
